content: {"episode_id":"ep-05010","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope (R55) occurring in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10) and unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91). The clinical indication note documents that monitoring is needed to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring. The service was therefore medically necessary as documented in the submitted records, and we request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial."}
